IS 1217 : 2024 Tar and Bituminous Materials - Determination of Mineral Matter (Ash) - Methods of Test
ICS 75.140
ICS 75.140
PCD 06
PCD 06
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the method for determination of mineral matter (ash) for crude coal tar, pitch and other bituminous products.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in the text constitute provisions of this standard, at the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreement, based on the standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of this standard.
